title: Drag Chain Conveyor
model_title: En-Masse Drag Chain Conveyor (Enclosed, Flighted Chain)

introduction.definition: A drag chain (en-masse) conveyor moves bulk solids inside an enclosed casing. A chain with flights runs along the bottom; the flights drag the material, and because the material moves as a solid mass with the chain (the "en-masse" principle), the bed moves even above the flights. It is dust-tight, gentle, and can run horizontal, inclined or vertical.
applications: Hot and abrasive materials (with suitable liners)
key_points: Chain elongation and wear are the main issues

foundation: Support the conveyor stringers and drive frames on steelwork or plinths designed for belt tension, material load and drive torque.
alignment: Survey the structure so all pulleys and idlers are square to the centre line; train the belt empty, then loaded.
piping: Chutes designed for the material trajectory to centre-load the belt; skirts and dust seals at loading points; belt cleaners and plough at the discharge.
commissioning: Check pull-wire emergency stops, belt-drift and speed switches; run empty and loaded; record take-up position and motor current.

periodic.task: Measure chain elongation; inspect flights and liners.

overhaul.task: Replace chain and sprockets together when worn.

lubrication: Gearmotor oil; take-up screws and bearings greased.

safety: Lock out before opening inspection doors; chain nip at sprockets.

video_tutorials.title: Drag Chain Conveyor — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Drag Chain Conveyor.
A drag chain (en-masse) conveyor moves bulk solids inside an enclosed casing.

A chain with flights runs along the bottom; the flights drag the material, and because the material moves as a solid mass with the chain (the "en-masse" principle), the bed moves even above the flights.
It is dust-tight, gentle, and can run horizontal, inclined or vertical.
Typical applications include cement, clinker and raw meal; grain and feed handling; coal, ash and wood chips; hot and abrasive materials (with suitable liners).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Enclosed Casing (dust-tight) with Inlet & Outlet, Inlet Spout & Bottom Outlet Gate.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Drag Chain Conveyor — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Drag Chain Conveyor.
Check chain tension and noise.
Measure chain elongation; inspect flights and liners.
Replace chain and sprockets together when worn.
Watch for chain elongation: chain jumps sprockets, noise. Common cause: wear of pins/bushes.
Watch for casing floor wear: holes, leaks. Common cause: abrasive material.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
